# Camp Resource: Turbo-Fert Fertilizer Collector

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 5, 2024
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e7141f4f8e4b4ed78752b7045c6c9ae6~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Produces Turbo-Fert Fertilizer which can be equipped and thrown like a grenade to instantly grow any Workshop plants!

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- AVAILABLE FOR GOLD BULLION PER CHARACTER. -

-C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Turbo-Fert Fertilizer Collector__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7d69d1fea8f94278ab706e3a2499ca44~mv2.png)

**Produces**

Turbo Fertilizer Grenades

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

1 Turbo Fertilizer Grenade

**Obtainable via** 

Gold Bullion - Samuel - Ally - 750 Bullion

Gold Bullion - Minerva - List 10

**Produces X amount per**

4 minutes and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

9 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
